weaknesses.what: '録音中' (recording) and '音が届いていません' (no audio reaching it) sit right next to each other and contradict each other, with no explanation of which is true or what to do about it.
weaknesses.fix: Resolve the conflicting states into one clear status (e.g. 'recording but no sound detected — check your mic') instead of showing both a green-light label and a red-flag warning at once.

weaknesses.what: Empty 決まったこと and やること sections just repeat 'を待っています…', which reads as generic filler rather than useful information at first glance.
weaknesses.fix: Replace with a lighter, more specific empty state (e.g. hide the section until the first item lands, or show a one-line hint of what will appear there).

weaknesses.what: The floating black toolbar pill at the top is visually the loudest element on the screen but is functionally separate from the meeting panel beneath it, splitting attention before the user even reads the meeting content.
weaknesses.fix: Reduce the toolbar's visual weight (lighter fill or smaller footprint) or dock it into the same surface as the '録音中' status so they read as one control, not two.

weaknesses.what: 『音が届いていません』という警告と、実際には発言が3件文字起こしされ続けている状態が矛盾して見え、AIが正しく機能しているか初見では判断できない。
weaknesses.fix: 警告が出る条件を音声が本当に途絶えた時だけに限定するか、直近に文字起こしが更新されていれば警告を自動的に消す/弱める。

weaknesses.what: 『決まったこと』『やること』が空のまま『〜を待っています…』と表示され、下の『メモ』には既に具体的な内容が入っているため、同じ会議内で情報の充実度がちぐはぐに見える。
weaknesses.fix: 空欄セクションの見た目をより控えめ(グレーアウトや折りたたみ)にして、実データがあるメモ欄との対比を弱める。

weaknesses.what: 配色・装飾ともに機能一辺倒で、AIが役に立っていると感じさせる演出(強調・アニメーション等)がなく淡々とした印象。
weaknesses.fix: メモが新規追加された瞬間に軽いハイライトやフェードインを入れるなど、AIの働きが視覚的に伝わる小さな演出を加える。

weaknesses.what: 'Cannot hear audio' message conflicts with the fact that the AI is clearly capturing speech and timestamps. This creates uncertainty about whether something is broken or if this is expected.
weaknesses.fix: Remove misleading audio warnings, or clarify that audio monitoring is working. Use clear status indicators (recording, processing, ready).

weaknesses.what: 'Waiting for...' placeholder sections in Decided Items and Things to Do break the flow. You see some notes filled in (Memo section) but other sections appear empty, making it unclear if extraction is complete.
weaknesses.fix: Either hide incomplete sections entirely, show a consistent loading state, or populate all sections before showing the UI. Avoid mixing filled and placeholder content.

weaknesses.what: No explanation of who these speakers are, what project this relates to, or why this meeting matters. The three-digit meeting code '02:38' is cryptic.
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle header with meeting title, date, participant list, or meeting purpose above the current title.

weaknesses.what: The right panel with transcription snippets is sparse and requires scrolling. The bottom message 'AI is viewing material -- not yet available' wastes vertical space without adding information.
weaknesses.fix: Either show more transcription content, hide the unavailable materials message, or use that space for meeting summary or action items in a more compact way.
